option_relations.rationale: The option describes bacterial skull base osteomyelitis, which is not directly related to invasive fungal sinusitis. While the patient has rhinosinusitis, the cultures grew bacteria, not fungi, and there was no evidence of fungus on pathological tests.
The option describes CN7 paresis secondary to acute bacterial sinusitis. While the patient has facial paresis and bacterial sinusitis, this is not directly related to invasive fungal sinusitis.

The option describes an orbital abscess secondary to bacterial rhinosinusitis. While the patient has an orbital abscess and bacterial rhinosinusitis, this is not directly related to invasive fungal sinusitis.

The option describes chronic rhinosinusitis with orbital cellulitis/abscess. While the patient has chronic rhinosinusitis and an orbital abscess, this is not directly related to invasive fungal sinusitis.
